edges.reason: The oxeye_daisy is in the same garden zone as the sweet_berry_bush; player must navigate to this area first to find and mine the flower
The honeycomb_block wall is in the garden zone near the berry bushes; player discovers this area by finding the bushes first
Honeycomb blocks physically wall off the crafting table at (4,0,-9); player must mine through them to access the table for crafting
The red_sandstone_slabs border the nether canyon adjacent to the lavafall; player must navigate to the lava area to find and mine the slabs
The quartz_slab floor is in the same nether canyon as the lavafall; player discovers both features in the same eastern area
Finding the white_bed means the player has located and entered the dark house; they can then place torches to illuminate it
